column3: NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “I do not lack” is rendered “I shall not want.”
Close to the Hebrew; “waters of rest” is rendered “quiet waters.”
“A valley of deep darkness” is rendered “the valley of the shadow of death,” and “harm” as “evil.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my cup is saturation” is rendered “My cup overflows.”
“Covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness,” and “pursue” as “follow”; the Hebrew “I will return” is rendered “I will dwell,” and “for length of days” as “forever.”
